caption:
A US doctor just gave her entire life's savings to the hospital that trained her. Roughly Rs 20 crore, to a government hospital in Andhra Pradesh.

Dr. Uma Devi Gavini, an immunologist who graduated from Guntur Medical College in 1965 before moving to the US, pledged her savings at the college's North America alumni reunion in Dallas in September 2026. The gift will fund a new mother-and-child care block at the hospital where she trained - named after her late husband, not after herself.

Most people build a career and keep what they earn. She built one, then sent almost all of it back to where she started.

Sources: Eastern Eye, The Quint
